issue.title: AttributeError: 'zip' object has no attribute 'shape'

labels.name: type:support
labels.description: User is asking for help / asking an implementation question. Stackoverflow would be better suited.

issue.body: Please make sure that this is a Bug or a Feature Request and provide all applicable information asked by the template. If your issue is an **implementation question**, please ask your question on [StackOverflow](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/keras) or [on the Keras Slack channel](https://keras-slack-autojoin.herokuapp.com/) instead of opening a GitHub issue. **System information** - Have I written custom code (as opposed to using example directory): - OS Platform and Distribution (e.g., Linux Ubuntu 16.04): Google Colab - TensorFlow backend (yes / no): yes - TensorFlow version: 1.14.0 - Keras version: - Python version: 3.6 - CUDA/cuDNN version: 10.0 - GPU model and memory: 15GB You can obtain the TensorFlow version with: python -c "import tensorflow as tf; print(tf.GIT_VERSION, tf.VERSION)" You can obtain the Keras version with: python -c 'import keras as k; print(k.__version__)' **Describe the current behavior** I was writing an image generator for segmentation. As mentioned in docs how to use `zip`, I used in the same way but it through me error as mentioned above

body:
I think `fit_generator` used to support python iterators and it no longer does, I believe that changed in v1.13. 

This doc page seem to be out of date: https://www.tensorflow.org/versions/r2.0/api_docs/python/tf/keras/preprocessing/image/ImageDataGenerator

I have the same problem, `AttributeError: 'zip' object has no attribute 'shape'`
This is my code:
```python
data_gen_args = dict(rotation_range=0.2,
                    width_shift_range=0.05,
                    height_shift_range=0.05,
                    shear_range=0.05,
                    zoom_range=0.05,
                    horizontal_flip=True,
                    fill_mode='nearest',
                    rescale=1./255)

image_generator = tf.keras.preprocessing.image.ImageDataGenerator(data_gen_args)
mask_generator = tf.keras.preprocessing.image.ImageDataGenerator(data_gen_args)

imageGenerator = image_generator.flow_from_directory('membrane/train',color_mode="grayscale",classes=['image'],class_mode=None,batch_size=5)
maskGenerator = mask_generator.flow_from_directory('membrane/train',color_mode="grayscale",classes=['label'],class_mode=None,batch_size=5)

train_generator = zip(imageGenerator, maskGenerator)


history = model.fit_generator(train_generator,steps_per_epoch=100,epochs=3)
```

issue.title: Keras and Colaboratory have issues with versioning

repository.name: segmed
repository.description: Applying Deep Learning to medical image segmentation tasks.

issue.body:
It seems that the new TensorFlow 2.0 hasn't arrived in Colaboratory and I can't seem to make it work.

A pure TensorFlow implementation is not very useful when this is the case, so a Keras one should also be available.
